definitions.explanation: The imaginary line at roughly 180° longitude that marks where the calendar date changes. Almost always appears in the full form {日付変更線|ひづけへんこうせん}; the short form is used only after the full term has been established.

examples.japanese: {日付|ひづけ}{変更線|へんこうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}えた→越える：02099_koeru⟧。
examples.english: We crossed the International Date Line.

examples.japanese: {変更線|へんこうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{西|にし}→西：00659_nishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Crossing the date line going west moves the date forward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太平洋|たいへいよう}→太平洋：09680_taiheiyou⟧⟦{上空|じょうくう}→上空：03080_joukuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{日付|ひづけ}{変更線|へんこうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通過|つうか}→通過：03506_tsuuka⟧し、⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: We passed the International Date Line over the Pacific and the calendar went back one day.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧ (change) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line). The standalone word is uncommon; the standard term is {日付|ひづけ}{変更線|へんこうせん} (date-change line).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日付|ひづけ}{変更線|へんこうせん}: International Date Line (full term)
- {変更線|へんこうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧: to cross the date line
- {変更線|へんこうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通過|つうか}する→通過する：22435_tsuukasuru⟧: to pass over the date line

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{経度|けいど}→経度：00209_keido⟧: longitude — the angular measure, not the dateline itself
- ⟦{時差|じさ}→時差：03075_jisa⟧: time difference — between time zones, related but distinct concept
